items.source: Supports HTTP cache control options. The usage of corresponding HTTP headers can be controlled via the "cacheSeconds" and "cacheControl" properties.
items.translation: 支持 HTTP 缓存控制选项。可以通过 `"cacheSeconds"` 和 `"cacheControl"` 属性来控制相应 HTTP 标头的使用。

items.source: For more specific needs, a custom CacheControl should be used.
items.translation: 对于更具体的需求，应使用自定义的CacheControl。

items.source:
Default is GET, HEAD and POST for simple form controller types;
unrestricted for general controllers and interceptors.
items.translation: 默认情况下，简单表单控制器类型为 GET、HEAD 和 POST；通用控制器和拦截器则不受限制。

items.source: Return the "Allow" header value to use in response to an HTTP OPTIONS request based on the configured supported methods also automatically adding "OPTIONS" to the list even if not present as a supported method. This means subclasses don't have to explicitly list "OPTIONS" as a supported method as long as HTTP OPTIONS requests are handled before making a call to checkRequest(HttpServletRequest).
items.translation: 返回“允许”标头值，以响应基于配置的支持方法的 HTTP OPTIONS 请求，并且会自动将"OPTIONS"添加到列表中，即使它不是支持的方法。这意味着只要在处理 HTTP OPTIONS 请求之前调用checkRequest(HttpServletRequest)，子类就不必显式地将"OPTIONS"列为支持的方法。

items.source:
Prepare the given response according to the settings of this generator.
Applies the number of cache seconds specified for this generator.
items.translation: 应用此生成器指定的缓存秒数。

items.source:
Apply the given cache seconds and generate corresponding HTTP headers,
i.e. allow caching for the given number of seconds in case of a positive
value, prevent caching if given a 0 value, do nothing else.
Does not tell the browser to revalidate the resource.
items.translation: 应用给定的缓存秒数并生成相应的 HTTP 标头，即如果值为正数则允许缓存该数量的秒数，如果值为 0 则防止缓存，除此之外不做其他操作。这不会指示浏览器重新验证资源。

items.source: restrictDefaultSupportedMethods - true if this generator should support HTTP methods GET, HEAD and POST by default, or false if it should be unrestricted
items.translation: `restrictDefaultSupportedMethods` - 如果此生成器默认应支持 HTTP 方法 GET、HEAD 和 POST，则为true；否则为false（表示无限制）

items.source: supportedMethods - the supported HTTP methods for this content generator
items.translation: supportedMethods - 此内容生成器支持的 HTTP 方法

items.source: varyByRequestHeaders - one or more request header names
items.translation: varyByRequestHeaders - 一个或多个请求头名称

items.source: jakarta.servlet.ServletException - if the request cannot be handled because a check failed
items.translation: jakarta.servlet.ServletException - 如果检查失败导致无法处理请求，则抛出此异常。

items.source: cacheControl - the pre-configured cache control settings
items.translation: cacheControl - 预配置的缓存控制设置

items.source: cacheSeconds - positive number of seconds into the future that the response should be cacheable for, 0 to prevent caching
items.translation: cacheSeconds - 表示响应可缓存的未来秒数（正数），设为 0 则禁止缓存。

items.source: seconds == -1 (default value): no generation cache-related headers
items.translation: seconds == -1（默认值）：不生成与缓存相关的响应头。

items.source: seconds == 0: "Cache-Control: no-store" will prevent caching
items.translation: seconds == 0: "Cache-Control: no-store" 将防止缓存。

items.source: seconds > 0: "Cache-Control: max-age=seconds" will ask to cache content
items.translation: seconds > 0："Cache-Control: max-age=seconds" 将要求缓存内容。

items.source: Prepare the given response according to the settings of this generator.
items.translation: 请根据此生成器的设置准备给定的响应。

items.source:
Cache content for the given number of seconds, by writing
cache-related HTTP headers to the response:

seconds == -1 (default value): no generation cache-related headers
seconds == 0: "Cache-Control: no-store" will prevent caching
seconds > 0: "Cache-Control: max-age=seconds" will ask to cache content
items.translation:
为给定的秒数缓存内容，通过向响应写入与缓存相关的 HTTP 头：

seconds == -1（默认值）：不生成与缓存相关的头
seconds == 0："Cache-Control: no-store"将防止缓存
seconds > 0："Cache-Control: max-age=seconds"将请求缓存内容

items.source: Set the HTTP methods that this content generator should support.
items.translation: 设置此内容生成器应支持的 HTTP 方法。

items.source:
Configure one or more request header names (for example, "Accept-Language") to
add to the "Vary" response header to inform clients that the response is
subject to content negotiation and variances based on the value of the
given request headers.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个请求头名称（例如，"Accept-Language"），将其添加到"Vary"响应头中，以告知客户端响应受内容协商影响，且会根据给定请求头的值而变化。

items.source:
Configure one or more request header names (for example, "Accept-Language") to
add to the "Vary" response header to inform clients that the response is
subject to content negotiation and variances based on the value of the
given request headers. The configured request header names are added only
if not already present in the response "Vary" header.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个请求头名称（例如，"Accept-Language"），将其添加到响应头"Vary"中，以告知客户端响应受内容协商影响，且会根据给定请求头的值而变化。如果响应头"Vary"中尚未存在这些配置的请求头名称，则仅添加它们。
